abc.why: The drawn select wire of the 4-leg switch B4 (SI0304). The switch takes its legs from the conditions written beside it, (1) ~ (4) IF BNR-A ~ D OIL FLOW CONTROL REMOTE (M.009A ~ M.009D), read as signals (audit-fix ABC-003E-1, plant.js q4.sig). The wire itself carries no other signal.

Memory list 101 M.3403 LIMESTONE FEEDER TRIP (BC FROM S4), 'FROM STN104 STATION WIRING'. No sheet of the app (ABC, DITL, DITL-LS) writes it: the STN104 station wiring sheet that sends it is not in the drawing set read by the app. It feeds AMT B11 and OR B39 -> M.0148 (SOx control force manual).

The 4-leg switch B32 (SI0199) selects by (1) ~ (4) IF A ~ D-ASH COOLER AUTO (M.021A ~ M.021D; memory list 101 'A-ASH SCREW COOLER CTRL AUTO ONLY (FIRST AUTO)', 'B ~ D ... AUTO ONLY'). No sheet makes M.021A ~ D, so the conditions are user settings (0). The fix needs the switch evaluated every scan (it is evaluated only when its own wires change); engine slice after the gate.
